title: Wrong default TT values used
body:
Build: bs551caffc-2025.05.10

- I'm using mmol/L
- In simple mode

While inputting carbs, and using TT (in this example, I was using TT Activity), the app pulls default values from mg/dL.
140 mmol/L is fairly... out of reach.

Workaround: Disabling simple mode allows the app to pull correct data.

But it's something that should be looked at, seeing as it effectivly makes the TT options on the carb popup (while in simple mode) useless if its pulling the wrong values.
